settings.termsBody:
Mu gufungura konte canke gukoresha MUHETO, wemera aya mabwirizwa yo gukoresha.

1. Ibirimwo bisohotswe
Uguma umunyamwabo w'amashusho n'ivyo usohora. Mu kubisohora, uduha uburenganzira bwo kubibika no kubikwiza muri porogaramu. Wemera kutasohora ikirimwo icarico cose kidasanzwe, gitera urwanko, canke gitera urugomo.

2. Konte y'ukoresha
Urafise inshingano yo kubika ijambo ry'ibanga ryawe mu bwiherero. Ushobora gusiba konte yawe igihe icarico cose uhereye ku Igenamiterere.

3. MUHETO Gold
Amabwirizwa y'ubwishuzi n'ihagarikwa ry'ubwiyunge bwa Gold azosobanurwa imbere y'itangwa rya kare ry'ubwishuzi.

4. Igenzurwa
MUHETO ifise uburenganzira bwo gukura ikirimwo cose canke guhagarika konte iyariyo yose itubahiriza aya mabwirizwa.

5. Aho gushikirwa
Ku bibazo vyose: contact@muheto.app

⚠️ Iki gitabu ni icitegererezo co gutangura kandi kigomba kurabwa n'inzobere mu mategeko imbere y'itangwa rya nyakuri.
